edits:
- name: Deep interaction regression suite
        id: deep-browser
        run: node tools/capture-deep-audit.mjs
      - name: Upload deep interaction evidence
        if: always() && steps.deep-browser.outcome != 'skipped' && steps.deep-browser.outcome != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deep-interaction-audit-${{ github.sha }}
          path: .artifacts/deep-audit
          if-no-files-found: error
scoreDescription: english ? "Composite technical score, not a calibrated probability of profit" : "تقييم فني مركب من 100؛ ليس احتمال ربح مضموناً"
